component.name: Pinto Slicer
component.summary: Prepare, support, slice, and export resin 3D prints

description.p: Pinto Slicer is a Linux-first resin 3D printer slicer built with Rust, egui, and wgpu. It provides a graphical workspace and command-line tools for preparing models and exporting native printer jobs.

ul.li: Move, rotate, scale, mirror, align, and arrange STL and OBJ models
Generate configurable automatic supports with presets
Inspect sliced exposure masks with layer playback
Save self-contained projects with embedded meshes
Export twelve job formats at native printer panel resolutions

description.p: Printer files have software-level validation, but physical-printer interoperability has not been verified. Run a small test print before starting a long job.

screenshot.caption: Automatic support generation on the build plate

description.p: The first public release of Pinto Slicer, with packages for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

ul.li: Interactive model preparation and automatic support generation
Layer preview, project files, and native printer-job export
Linux AppImage and Flatpak, universal macOS DMG, and portable Windows ZIP
